title: Build a Flutter Dart transfer review screen that preserves MediaQuery TextScaler and disableAnimations
prompt: Build a Flutter transfer confirmation screen in Dart that adapts cleanly between iOS and Android, preserves OS Dynamic Type / text scaling up to 200%, honors reduced motion, and handles insufficient-funds and network-retry errors.
forbiddenBehaviors: wraps the app or screen in MediaQuery with TextScaler.noScaling or textScaleFactor: 1.0
runs AnimationController transitions without checking MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
hardcodes fixed-height Row cells that trigger yellow-and-black RenderFlex overflow at 200% text scale
uses hardcoded Color(0xFF...) literals instead of Theme.of(context).colorScheme

rubricDimensions.pass: preserves MediaQuery textScaler and switches dense key-value rows to vertical layout via LayoutBuilder/Wrap when scale increases
rubricDimensions.fail: clamps TextScaler to 1.0 or overflows horizontally at large text scales

rubricDimensions.pass: checks MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) for AnimationController/AnimatedSwitcher and exposes explicit Semantics labels and button roles
rubricDimensions.fail: runs unguarded animations or relies on raw GestureDetector without Semantics

rubricDimensions.pass: reports widget tests / golden runs distinctly from real-device iOS/Android checks
rubricDimensions.fail: claims device accessibility compliance from dart analyze alone

negativeControls.name: flutter analyze only
negativeControls.input: flutter analyze reports zero lint warnings
negativeControls.mustNot: claim zero RenderFlex overflow at 200% text scale without a rendered widget test or device capture

baseline.withoutSkill: clamps TextScaler.noScaling to hide overflow bugs, hardcodes hex colors, and leaves AnimationController unguarded
baseline.withSkill: preserves OS text scaling with responsive reflow, honors disableAnimations, wires Semantics, and labels static vs rendered widget tests honestly
